<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="27" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">9:41</text>
    <line x1="321" y1="22" x2="321" y2="27" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="19" x2="326" y2="27" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="16" x2="331" y2="27" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="346" cy="22" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="26" x2="350" y2="26" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="360" y="16" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="19" width="15" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#333333"/>
    <rect x="383" y="20" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#333333"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="52" width="62" height="32" rx="5" fill="#F5C418"/>
    <text x="51" y="74" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">IMDb</text>
    <text x="20" y="119" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Create your account</text>
    <text x="20" y="145" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Join IMDb to rate movies and build your watchlist.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Username -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="174" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Username</text>
    <rect x="20" y="182" width="350" height="46" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="34" y="211" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">e.g. cinephile_92</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Email -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="254" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Email address</text>
    <rect x="20" y="262" width="350" height="46" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="34" y="291" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">name@example.com</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Password -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="334" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Password</text>
    <rect x="20" y="342" width="350" height="46" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="34" y="371" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">••••••••••••</text>
    <ellipse cx="345" cy="365" rx="10" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="345" cy="365" r="2.5" fill="#646F79"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="374" x2="353" y2="356" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Confirmation -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="414" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Confirm password</text>
    <rect x="20" y="422" width="350" height="46" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="34" y="451" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">••••••••••••</text>
    <ellipse cx="345" cy="445" rx="10" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="345" cy="445" r="2.5" fill="#646F79"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="454" x2="353" y2="436" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <text x="20" y="489" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Use at least 8 characters with a number or symbol.</text>

  <!-- Terms -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="512" width="20" height="20" rx="4" fill="#F5C418" stroke="#F5C418" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polyline points="25,522 29,526 36,518" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="50" y="527" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">I agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Primary button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="552" width="350" height="48" rx="8" fill="#F2C94C"/>
    <text x="195" y="582" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Create IMDb account</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Divider -->
  <g>
    <line x1="20" y1="625" x2="164" y2="625" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="226" y1="625" x2="370" y2="625" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="629" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">or continue with</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Social buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="646" width="169" height="44" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="668" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#477FFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="48" y="673" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#477FFF">G</text>
    <text x="116" y="673" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Google</text>

    <rect x="201" y="646" width="169" height="44" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="229" cy="668" r="9" fill="#477FFF"/>
    <text x="229" y="674" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">f</text>
    <text x="297" y="673" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Facebook</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Login prompt -->
  <g>
    <text x="126" y="729" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Already have an account?</text>
    <text x="135" y="729" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#F2C94C">Log in</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="47,797 57,789 67,797" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <rect x="50" y="796" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="57" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Search -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="146" cy="798" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="152" y1="804" x2="158" y2="810" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="146" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Search</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Wishlist -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="235,790 241,796 247,790 253,796 253,805 241,812 229,805 229,796" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="241" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Wishlist</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Profile active -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="333" cy="796" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#F2C94C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="333" cy="807" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#F2C94C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="333" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#F2C94C">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
